_source: YouTube 'I Copied a World Champion's Method on NIFTY' (Trading Siddhant, Sep-2026): Direction -> Area -> Trigger. Edit numbers here, not in code.

direction._rule: Direction (his 'environment') on the 1-hour chart: up, down or sideways/choppy. Change of direction only after the extreme breaks AND is retested (N shape); moves inside that range are smaller structure. Uses the app's BOS/CHoCH engine on 1-hour candles built from 15-min.

area._rule: Swing low -> high on 1-hour, Fibonacci retracement 0.705 / 0.79 / 0.886. Uptrend: between 0.705 and 0.886 = DISCOUNT = buy area; below 0.886 = idea invalid, no trade. Downtrend mirror = PREMIUM sell area. Other areas he marks: previous highs/lows where price stopped, gaps, round numbers (24,000).

trigger._rule: Pin bar on 15-min inside the zone (wick >= 2x body and >= half the candle), closing back on the trend side of the 0.886 level. He also needs footprint delta (aggressive sellers at the top of a bearish pin, 400% imbalance) - no footprint data here, candle only.

risk._rule: Target = the swing extreme (previous swing high for a buy). He takes 1.5-2 R and wins 60-65%. SL beyond the pin bar or the 0.886 level, whichever is further.

time._rule: Trade only while volume is there: the first ~1.5 hours (he trades 09:15-11:00) and the post-lunch spike; dead volume gives no move. Intraday: anything open is closed at the session's last candle.

discipline._rule: No trade some days; no back-to-back trades; journal every trade; no revenge trade, no over-sizing. The line in the sand must be kept. (Reminder only.)

context_in_app._rule: Also in his checklist and already in your briefing: option-chain OI read the WRITERS' way (more call OI = call writers = bearish), and GEX (positive gamma = dealers sell rips / buy dips = range; negative = trending).
